column2: # Adhesion comes from script 3's output, so each number has one source.
# Log metrics are drawn as % difference from control, extension as a difference in mm.
lo     = to_plot(ci_low, scale),          hi     = to_plot(ci_high, scale),
lo_dun = to_plot(ci_low_dunnett, scale),  hi_dun = to_plot(ci_high_dunnett, scale),
p_vs <- ggplot(vs, aes(x = arm, y = y)) +
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo_dun, ymax = hi_dun), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +   # Dunnett
geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), linewidth = 1.6, color = "grey30") +     # unadjusted
geom_point(aes(fill = arm), shape = 21, size = 3.8, stroke = 0.8, color = "black") +
labs(x = NULL, y = "Day 3 vs control,\nadjusted for baseline",
caption = "Point: ANCOVA estimate. Thick bar: 95% CI. Whiskers: Dunnett 95% CI.") +
